_comment: Tier-2 spec for the api_keys repo (W4.7d, the last unported repo). SAFETY: testPepperBase64 is a THROWAWAY 32-byte key (shared across tier-2 fixtures); every key_value here is a SYNTHETIC placeholder — never a real API key. createApiKey mints id + timestamps (no CreateOptions), so this is the minted-values remap form: the harness remaps ids (first-seen in label order) and placeholders the minted timestamp columns (createdAt / updatedAt / lastUsed). The seed fixture carries ONE malformed raw row (empty provider) to exercise getApiKeysByUserId's safeParse drop.
_isActiveRowsComment: P4.139: six raw rows (user C — no getByUser op reads them) whose isActive cell is a value v4 writes never but a foreign or hand-edited row can carry. v4's hydrate (backend.ts:412-450): NULL -> undefined -> Zod default true; a number -> value === 1; anything else -> Boolean(value). Each is read back by literal id through findApiKeyById (the readIsActive op) and recorded {id, isActive}. isActiveSql is a SQL literal spliced into the INSERT so each cell lands with its exact storage class.
_corruptKeyRowComment: P4.139: a user-A row whose key_value is a BLOB — v4's hydrate decodes the stray Buffer as Float32 and ApiKeySchema.safeParse refuses it, so getApiKeysByUserId DROPS the row with its WARN and lists the rest; v5's marshal answers InvalidColumnType on the same cell. The getByUser op for user A therefore keeps its healthy label set.
